name: Chained
intro: The Chained pathway focuses on restraint, curses, mutation and control. Its supernatural strength comes from binding enemies and surviving through abnormal transformations.

meter.name: Restraint
meter.gain: Enduring damage while containing a curse
meter.full: Release the contained curse before it backlashes

ability.name: Shackled Endurance
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Shackled Endurance — +15% DEF; +15% Physical direct-damage resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Madness Curse
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Madness Curse — Deals 120% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Physical damage (22% base DEF bypass); Enemy SPEED −15% for 2 turns; Contain one self-inflicted Curse for 4 turns. At 100 charge, remove it and release 30% Max HP as Dark damage.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Possession Phase
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Possession Phase — 100% chance: negates direct physical damage for 1 turn; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.label: Active
